definitions.explanation: Established or operated by a city government. Used primarily for institutions such as schools, hospitals, libraries, and parks.

examples.japanese: {市立|しりつ}⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the city library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{市立|しりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My daughter goes to a municipal junior high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{市立|しりつ}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: This city hospital plays an important role as the center of regional healthcare.

notes:
Because {市立|しりつ} and ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧ are homophones, speakers sometimes disambiguate by reading {市立|しりつ} as いちりつ in conversation. This is especially common when discussing schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市立|しりつ}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: city hospital
- {市立|しりつ}⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧: city library
- {市立|しりつ}⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧: city elementary school
- {市立|しりつ}⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧: city art museum

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧: private (homophone — distinguished as しりつ vs. わたくしりつ in speech)
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧: national (government-run)
- ⟦{県立|けんりつ}→県立：21885_kenritsu⟧: prefectural
- ⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧: public (general term for government-run institutions)
- {府立|ふりつ}: established by an urban prefecture (Osaka/Kyoto)
- ⟦{都立|とりつ}→都立：27990_toritsu⟧: established by Tokyo Metropolitan Government
